description: This file defines a class 'Functions' within the 'Matrix' namespace, providing static methods for matrix operations such as validation, adjoint, cofactors, determinant, diagonal, antidiagonal, identity, inverse, minors, trace, and transpose.

classes.name: Functions
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various matrix operations such as validation, calculation of adjoint, cofactors, determinant, diagonals, identity, inverse, minors, trace, and transpose.

methods.name: adjoint
methods.description: Calculates the adjoint (classical adjoint) of a square matrix, which is the transpose of its cofactor matrix.

methods.name: cofactors
methods.description: Calculates the cofactors matrix of a square matrix.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Calculates the determinant of a square matrix.

methods.name: diagonal
methods.description: Extracts the main diagonal of a square matrix.

methods.name: antidiagonal
methods.description: Extracts the anti-diagonal of a square matrix.

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Creates an identity matrix of the same size as the input square matrix.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of a square matrix with a non-zero determinant.

methods.name: minors
methods.description: Calculates the minors of a matrix.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Calculates the trace (sum of main diagonal elements) of a square matrix.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Returns the transpose of a matrix.
